description: This file defines the CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler class responsible for handling web view script messages related to UI actions in the OpenClaw application. It includes logic for message processing, URL validation, and communication with a backend gateway.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: A class that handles message events from a WKWebView, processes actions related to the Canvas application, and communicates with a gateway backend.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks whether a given URL points to a local network canvas, based on scheme and host/IP.

methods.name: userContentController(_:didReceive:)
methods.description: Main handler called when the web view receives a script message; processes messages with specific names related to user actions.
